  • Communication: Exceptional executive presence; ability to move seamlessly from a technical discussion with a Basis Lead to a strategic ROI pitch with a CFO.
  • Ability to travel: We believe that our business is a people business and that trust is built in person. Between 25-50% travel required. 

Entrepreneurial Mindset: Proactive self-starter with the drive to build a territory from scratch and take full ownership of business growth.Languages: Professional fluency in both German and English (written and spoken).

What You will get: 

  • You can expect a job with responsible tasks and creative opportunities, an attractive salary and extensive benefits (including JobRad, Focus Friday and much more).
  • You have flexible working hours with us. In addition, you can work remotely from other EU countries by arrangement.
  • We support our employees with 5 fully paid sick days per child and subsidize childcare up to primary school age.
  • In addition to an individual onboarding and buddy program, we offer comprehensive training opportunities and english language classes.
  • We offer 30 days of paid vacation per year (based on a 5-day workweek) for optimal work-life balance.
  • Furthermore, you can expect an innovative and attractive workplace with flat hierarchies and respectful and solution-oriented communication.
  • Equity in a late-stage, high-growth leader backed by top-tier VC/PE firms.
  • The chance to represent the only cybersecurity solution endorsed by SAP.

 

About Onapsis:

Onapsis protects the business applications that run the global economy. The Onapsis Platform delivers vulnerability management, change assurance, and continuous compliance for business applications from leading vendors such as SAP, Oracle, and others. The Onapsis Platform is powered by the Onapsis Research Labs, the team responsible for the discovery and mitigation of more than 1,000 zero-day vulnerabilities in business applications.

 

Onapsis is headquartered in Boston, MA, with offices in Dallas, TX, Heidelberg, Germany, Bucharest, Romania, and Buenos Aires, Argentina, and proudly serves hundreds of the world's leading brands, including close to 30% of the Forbes Global 100, six of the top 10 automotive companies, five of the top 10 chemical companies, four of the top 10 technology companies, and three of the top 10 oil and gas companies.

Artificial Intelligence. Actual Impact.

At Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses.

We’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart: trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive.

So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops.

🚀 The Adventure Ahead

As a Technical Account Manager, you’re the trusted technical engine behind our enterprise customers' greatest learning transformations! You will embed yourself as an essential strategic partner, bridging high-level customer business goals with Docebo’s cutting-edge platform capabilities. In this role, you won't just solve problems—you'll architect long-term technical strategies, pilot innovative solutions, and ensure our customers unlock maximum value to become partners for life.

This is a fully remote position, open to candidates located in Germany.

⚡ The Day-to-Day

  • Architect the Future: Translate customer business and eLearning goals into long-term, scalable technical strategies using Docebo’s robust feature set.

  • Own the Technical Relationship: Take full technical and product ownership of your assigned enterprise accounts while collaborating closely with Account Teams on commercial growth.

  • Serve as the Trusted Advisor: Guide executive and technical stakeholders through platform innovations, API integrations, and AI-assisted workflows to maximize operational efficiency.

  • Proactively Protect Platform Health: Monitor technical performance metrics—like API usage and login trends—to catch and mitigate potential risks long before they hit platform stability.

  • Lead Executive Technical Reviews: Deliver high-impact performance presentations on SLAs directly to customer leadership and champion customer feedback internally to Docebo teams.

  • Drive Systemic Platform Improvements: Partner with Premium Advisors and internal resources to analyze support case patterns, run proof-of-concept pilot projects, and streamline overall platform health.

💪 Your Superpowers

  • Enterprise SaaS Expertise: Bring 5+ years of SaaS technical troubleshooting and 2+ years of enterprise/large account management experience.

  • Integration & Auth Mastery: Hold a solid foundation in back-end practices, RESTful APIs, OAuth 2.0, SAML, and front-end essentials like JavaScript, CSS, and HTML.

  • Data & Middleware Savvy: Possess hands-on skills in at least two key areas: iPaaS tools (e.g., Workato, Zapier), SQL queries, or data warehousing/BI tools (e.g., Snowflake, Tableau, Power BI).

  • Executive Translator: Master the art of taking complex, highly technical concepts and translating them into simple, high-value business conversations for executive decision-makers.

  • Global Flexibility & Travel: Ready to support EMEA regional time zones and comfortable traveling internationally up to 25% of the time.

  • Project Management Mindset: Bring proactive ownership, analytical decision-making, and experience forecasting product release impacts or advising on AI/automation integrations.

  • German language proficiency is required; however, English is the primary language used for day-to-day communication and collaboration.

🌟 Bonus Points

  • Cloud Certified: Possess an active AWS Product Certification.

  • Domain Experience: Background in the e-Learning, Learning Management (LMS), or Human Capital Management (HCM) industries.

  • Scalability Specialist: Direct experience consulting on platform performance, high availability, uptime, and enterprise scalability.

Our Hybrid Work Philosophy 🤝

Great work can happen anywhere but coming together helps us go further. Our team spends three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday) to collaborate, solve problems, and learn from each other. With flexibility the rest of the week, it’s a balance designed to help everyone do their best work and keep growing.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy 🎉

Our Total Rewards Philosophy centers around three core areas to reward and care for our People:

  • Rewarding Impact: We lead with competitive pay to reward the impact, skills and traits that fuel our success.

  • Fostering Holistic Wellbeing: We care deeply about and invest in the whole person with programs that support our people’s physical, mental, and financial well-being.

  • Empowering Our Talent Culture: We build a culture of trust and empowerment by designing our rewards and benefits with transparency, equity, and flexibility, enabling our people to do their best work and stay for the long haul.

Our Promise to You 😍

  • Financial Wellness: Own a piece of Docebo through our Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) at a 15% discount, plus a competitive compensation package.

  • Your Well-Being, Covered: You’ll get access to health benefits, so you can get the care you need when you need it.

  • Family First: We provide coverage offering you time with your little one(s) so you can soak up all those precious moments. Fun fact: we had 30 Docebian babies join the family in 2025!

  • Connections That Count: Connect with global communities through our Employee Resource Groups (including PRIDE, DWA, BIDOC, and Green Ambassadors) and company-wide events that keep the fun rolling all year long.

About Docebo 💙

At Docebo, we create seamless, AI-powered learning experiences for over 3,000 customers worldwide. We have successfully achieved two IPOs (TSX: DCBO & NASDAQ: DCBO), been recognized as a top SaaS e-learning solution, and are growing exponentially in the process. We're a global company, with office across North America, EMEA, APAC, and beyond. Our team is guided by five core values—Grow Together Win Together, Build with Our Customer, Clear is Kind, Own Outcomes, Progress Over Perfection—that shape everything we do. If this resonates with you, now is the perfect time to join one of the fastest-growing learning technology companies in the world.

All qualified applicants and employees will receive consideration for employment regardless of their race, colour, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, citizenship status, age, disability, genetic information, or any other category protected under applicable law.

data.description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM helps governments and financial institutions detect and disrupt illicit finance, and this role brings that mission to central banks, financial regulators and financial intelligence units across EMEA. You will own the relationships and the revenue in a territory where digital asset supervision is growing fast, setting account strategy and closing six- and seven-figure deals with institutions that have long, careful buying processes. What makes this seat unusual is the chance to shape how TRM serves supervisors as MiCA and the EU AML package reshape their work.

The impact you will have:

  • Map your territory’s central banks, supervisors and FIUs, using AI tools to identify budget holders, decision-makers, champions and regulatory triggers so your first outreach reaches the right person.

  • Win six- and seven-figure deals by turning each institution’s supervisory and enforcement challenges into a clear business case, with AI-drafted account plans that you sharpen with your own judgment.

  • Build and maintain 3x qualified pipeline through targeted outreach, regional events and campaigns with Marketing, and measure what converts.

  • Navigate tenders, frameworks and call-offs with Solutions Architecture, Legal and Deal Desk, so each response is accurate and on time.

  • Grow live customers through renewals, expansion and referrals, using AI summaries of usage and call notes to spot expansion signals early.

  • Bring supervisory and customer insight back to Policy, Product and Marketing so the next release reflects how regulators in your region work.

What we’re looking for:

  • 6+ years selling SaaS, data intelligence or investigative solutions into central banks, financial regulators, FIUs or comparable government accounts in EMEA.

  • A record of closing six- and seven-figure deals and meeting quota across long, multi-stakeholder cycles.

  • Existing relationships within EMEA central banks, supervisors or FIUs, and credibility with senior officials.

  • Working knowledge of MiCA, the EU AML framework and how public sector buyers procure.

  • Hands-on use of AI for account research, planning and call preparation, with clear examples of time or revenue gained.

  • Credible, clear communication with senior executives, in person and virtually, and a knack for storytelling.

  • Fluent English; additional European languages are a plus.

  • Based in France, Belgium, Spain, Netherlands, willingness to travel regularly across the region.

About the Team:

  • TRM’s EMEA Sales team gives each Account Director real ownership of a territory and the room to choose how to win it.

  • The team is fast-paced, positive and collaborative, with shared pipeline insight and open sharing of what works.

  • The work is hard in a useful way: senior public sector buyers, several countries, long procurement cycles, and a category that is new to many supervisors.

  • You will work with Partnerships, Legal, Marketing, Policy and Product, who move quickly to back your deals.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within your first 30 days, you profile and stack-rank every central bank, regulator and FIU in your territory and start outreach to the top tier, so pipeline grows before onboarding ends.

  • When a regulator sends an urgent request late on a Friday for a same-day conversation and demo, you and TRM’s Solutions team make it happen that day.

  • When a government RFx lands with only a few days to respond, you rally Solutions Architecture and Deal Desk to deliver a high-quality response on time.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Distributed, not distant: the team works across UK and CET time zones, with occasional later calls for US-EMEA opportunities.

  • Slack is the center of day-to-day communication. @mention colleagues for timely responses.

  • Weekly 1:1 with your manager, a weekly team call, a weekly pipeline call, a weekly forecast call, and fortnightly pod calls.

  • Company-wide all-hands and founder Q&A sessions keep everyone connected to the mission.

Required online and collaboration hours:

  • Schedule: UK and CET core hours, with flexibility for occasional US-EMEA calls.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

data.title: Account Director, Southern Europe - Public Sector

data.description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM helps financial institutions detect and stop illicit finance, and this role brings that mission to private sector clients including banks, payment providers, crypto natives and fintechs across DACH. You will own the Private Sector business in a territory where TRM is building coverage, setting account strategy and strategic deals with compliance and risk leaders. What makes this seat unusual is a base of existing DACH customers to grow, plus real room to build new accounts and the freedom to shape your own go-to-market with local partners and AI-assisted research.

The impact you will have:

  • Open new private sector accounts across the DACH region. Working with internal and external stakeholders to build effective networks to deliver commercial execution of TRM’s services to leading private sector organisations across the region.

  • Win a mixture of high velocity and larger more strategic engagements, by turning AML and fraud pain points into a clear business case, with AI-drafted account plans and proposals that you sharpen with your own market judgment.

  • Own and define the model to build a 3x qualified pipeline each quarter through targeted campaigns, using AI-assisted segmentation and local-language messaging, and measure what converts.

  • Decide how TRM enters each market, choosing between direct selling, resellers, and regional partners, and back each choice with AI-assisted analysis of account data.

  • Grow strategic existing customers engagements through renewals, upsells, and new use cases.

  • Bring customer and regulatory insight back to Product and Marketing so the next release matches how banks in your region actually work.

What we’re looking for:

  • 5+ years selling SaaS or data products into banks, payment firms, crypto or fintechs in DACH, or 4+ years with deep AML and financial crime expertise, plus experience using AI tools to research and prioritize accounts.

  • A record of closing a mixture of quick deal cycle and strategic longer term, higher value engagements and meeting quota, with AI-supported forecasting and pipeline reviews.

  • Working knowledge of regional AML and sanctions frameworks and how compliance, risk, and procurement teams buy.

  • Hands-on use of AI for prospecting, account planning, and call preparation, with clear examples of time or revenue gained.

  • Experience building pipeline in a new territory, forming human lead networks and AI-assisted tools to test and measure what works.

  • Credible, clear communication with senior compliance and risk executives, in person and virtually, including AI-assisted preparation for each meeting.

  • Fluent German and English, French and additional relevant languages a bonus

  • Based in Germany and willingness to travel regularly across the region.

About the Team:

  • TRM’s EMEA Sales team gives each Account Director full ownership of a territory and the room to choose how to win it.

  • The team collaborates closely and supports one another through shared pipeline insight, deal reviews, and open sharing of what works.

  • The work is hard in a useful way: regulated buyers, several countries, long procurement cycles, and a product category that is still new to many banks.

  • You will work with RevOps, Marketing, Legal, Product, and Solutions Architecture, who move quickly to back your deals.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within your first 30 days, you rank every target bank and fintech in your territory and start outreach to the top tier, so pipeline grows before onboarding ends.

  • When a compliance leader asks for a demo late on a Friday, you and TRM’s Solutions team deliver it that day, turning a warm inquiry into a scheduled evaluation by Monday.

  • Within 90 days, you build qualified pipeline worth at least 3x your quota, backed by an account plan for every Tier 1 target.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Distributed, not distant: the team works across UK and CET time zones, and occasional US calls on complex deals.

  • Slack is the center of day-to-day communication. @mention colleagues for timely responses.

  • Weekly 1:1 with your manager, a weekly team call, a weekly pipeline call, a weekly forecast call, and regular pod calls.

  • Company-wide all-hands and founder Q&A sessions keep everyone connected to the mission.

Required online and collaboration hours:

  • Schedule: Core hours overlapping CET, with flexibility for occasional US calls.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

About Munich Electrification

Munich Electrification is an innovative company founded with the aim of accelerating the transition to electric and connected mobility. We develop innovative electronic control units for electric vehicles and stationary storage systems for our global customers. Our international team is composed of highly motivated and exceptional engineers. As a small and specialized team we are well-aware of the importance of each individual colleague and support and promote each employee according to their abilities and needs. Our office with adjacent prototype and testing lab is located in the heart of Munich at the Heimeranplatz.

This is what we stand for:

- Technological Leadership: We challenge norms, innovate quickly, and anticipate future needs. We take smart risks and learn from outcomes to stay ahead.

- Sustainability: We actively drive change for a sustainable future, aware of our impact and inspiring others to build a better world.

- Team Culture: We believe work should be enjoyable, fostering a spirit of inspiration, celebration, and teamwork across the globe.

- Entrepreneurial Spirit: We embrace change, think big, and push limits with passion.


Your Role:

Your primary mission is to own and evolve our Digital Ecosystem, ensuring our cloud-first infrastructure is as innovative and high-performing as our battery technology. You will ensure that our core platforms (Google Workspace and the Atlassian) function as a seamless, interconnected network that empowers our company. Acting as the vital bridge between business requirements and technical execution, you will master the configuration of existing solutions and be the technical lead for new application/service implementations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • SaaS & Cloud Governance: Act as the Platform Owner for Google Workspace and Atlassian, managing configurations, security, and permissions.

  • Business Process Evolution: Work with department heads to translate business needs into scalable digital workflows.

  • Vendor & Stakeholder Contact: Coordinate with external consultants and developers.

  • Documentation & Training: Maintain high-quality documentation of our application landscape and lead training sessions for power users.


Your Profile:

  • Education: Degree in Business Informatics, Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Experience: Min. 3-5 years of experience as a Full-time Cloud/IT Administrator. Proven track record in Application Management, specifically with MDM systems and Cloud/SaaS environments.

  • Technical Expertise: Good knowledge of Atlassian and Google Workspace administration.

  • Analytical Mindset: You enjoy mapping complex business processes into clean, digital solutions.

  • Communication: Fluent in English; German is a plus; Ability to explain technical concepts to non-IT stakeholders.

Optional:

  • Experience with AWS.

  • Experience with Google Cloud Identity & SSO integrations.

  • Certification in ITIL

  • SAP Knowledge: Practical experience with SAP (ByDesign or S/4HANA).

Our Offer & Benefits

The chance to be part of a highly innovative, agile, and unique team with prestigious customers in the automotive and battery storage sector. You will gain a deeper knowledge around connected & electric vehicle batteries, battery management and electronics development and strive in an exciting work environment

Benefits (Full-time Employees):

- Trust-based working hours and hybrid work

- Adequate and competitive compensation

- Pension Plan/Bonus

- Free access to the fitness center right next to us or subsidized EGYM Wellpass

- Free snacks, coffee, drinks and lunch (freshly cooked by our chef) every day

- Public transport ticket

- Bike-Leasing via Business Bike

- Experience various inspiring and fun team events

- ME-branded clothing

- Option to "work from anywhere" (6 weeks/year)

data.description:
We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to take on the hardest problems in the data and integration platform that everything at Nelly runs on: how practice data gets into Nelly from dozens of practice management systems, how partners connect to us, and how that data becomes something every product can depend on. At Staff level, your scope follows the problem, across teams and over time into product-wide questions.

The problem space: Every Nelly product, from documentation to billing to payments, depends on data that lives in a practice's management system. There are dozens of them, each with its own data model and interfaces.

How many practices we can serve, how much of their work we can automate, and how much they trust the result come down to four questions: can we connect, can we read and write deeply enough, is the data any good once it arrives, and can every product and team inside Nelly easily build on it?

About Nelly

We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, solving the biggest challenges for patients and practices. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people.

Why? Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality.

What sets us apart: We work with the best team, which is why we give everything together every day. We believe in Talent Density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. Stagnation isn’t an option, which is why we invest heavily in growth. AI is an essential part of how we work at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable.

Joining us, you will:

  • Own the strategy, metrics and roadmap for hard data and integration problems, from how data leaves a practice's system, through ingestion and modelling, to the products that rely on it, tied to real practice value and to how Nelly makes money

  • Shape how partners connect to Nelly through our External API, so we can serve practices on any system and open new markets beyond Germany

  • Define the core data every product relies on: what a patient, an appointment, a treatment plan or an invoice means, who owns it, and how fresh and reliable it is, with GDPR and health-data regulation built in from the start

  • Make data and integration quality measurable and visible, and move it, because practices feel a silent failure long before we do

  • Hold an end-to-end model of the platform and be a credible partner to engineering on architecture and trade-offs

What you'll bring:

  • Agency. You go after the problems that matter most, including well beyond your immediate scope, rather than waiting for a roadmap to land on your desk

  • Comfort in a high-velocity environment. You move fast, make bold but reversible calls, and challenge early and directly, including upward

  • Business-outcome orientation. You're genuinely data-driven: you can name the metric each project moves and let evidence, not gut feel, drive prioritisation

  • Technical fluency. You reason confidently about APIs, data models, data flows and how systems fit together, and you're a credible partner to senior engineers

  • You build with AI. You use AI to move faster: prototyping to pressure-test an idea, taking a first pass on the analysis or the spec yourself, shipping the small things directly, so your time goes to judgment and the decisions that move the product

  • 7+ years of product management experience

Even better if you have:

  • Built and shipped AI products

  • Worked on data platforms or data products

  • Built B2B SaaS in healthcare or another regulated industry

  • Professional German language knowledge

Our Interview Process:

  • Introduction to Nelly with TA

  • Product craft interview with our Product manager

  • Case study interview with Director of Product

  • Onsite interview with hiring manager and stakeholders

What we offer:

  • The people you get to work with. You will work alongside the brightest minds we could find, on hard problems, as a team. We take on challenges together and we never forget to have fun doing it.

  • Room to grow faster than almost anywhere else. New challenges, more scope, real ownership from day one. We trust you to own it and to speak up when something is wrong. Just do not expect to stand still.

  • A yearly learning and development budget, plus the coaching, feedback and internal knowledge that actually move you forward. Real investment in your learning.

  • A front row seat while we build something big. We are building the financial operating system for European healthcare, with AI woven into how we build, sell and support. Real scope, real impact.

  • Deutschlandticket or Swapfiets membership, so you get around the city fast.

  • Urban Sports Club membership, for sport and balance.

  • Flexible working hours and a hybrid setup.

  • Up to 4 weeks of workation.

  • A dog friendly office with great vibes and a team that is fun to work with.

We welcome applications from people of all genders and backgrounds, regardless of origin or age. If you're convinced you're the right fit for this role - even if your CV doesn't match the requirements 100% - tell us why.

Über Buena

Buena baut die Technologie, auf der die Immobilienbranche läuft. Wir machen jeden Teil der Immobilienwirtschaft so nahtlos und transparent wie möglich, vom Finden über das Finanzieren bis zum Verwalten. Dafür übernehmen wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und bauen sie zu Technologieunternehmen um. Mit über 90.000 verwalteten Einheiten und mehr als 30 übernommenen Hausverwaltungen sind wir in den letzten drei Jahren zu Deutschlands zweitgrößtem Immobilienverwalter geworden.

Du bist echter WEG-Profi, kennst den Alltag in der Verwaltung und weißt, wie du Ordnung reinbringst, wenn Abläufe stocken, Aufgaben liegen bleiben oder Prozesse unklar sind. Genau dort setzt du bei Buena an: Jeden Monat übernehmen wir neue Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland, und du überführst sie direkt vor Ort in den modernen Buena-Betrieb. Dein Wohnort in Deutschland ist zweitrangig – wichtig ist deine hohe Reisebereitschaft und deine WEG-Expertise. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich in funktionierenden Abläufen, reibungslosem WEG-Tagesgeschäft und lokalen Teams, die mit der Buena-Software spürbar besser arbeiten als vorher.

Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Du tauchst tief in das WEG-Tagesgeschäft unserer neu übernommenen Verwaltungen ein, identifizierst Engpässe frühzeitig und baust bestehende Rückstände gezielt ab.

  • Du begleitest und steuerst die operative Umstellung auf unsere Buena-Software direkt vor Ort bei den Teams.

  • Du schulst die Teams praxisnah an unserer Software und befähigst sie, Versammlungen, Beschlüsse und das Tagesgeschäft digital abzuwickeln.

  • Du bringst deine tiefen WEG-Erfahrungen aus den Einsätzen zurück in unser Product-Team, um unsere Software stetig zu verbessern.

Du passt gut, wenn du

  • Du hast mehrjährige fundierte Praxiserfahrung in der WEG-Verwaltung und kennst Versammlungen, Beschluss-Sammlungen und WEG-Sonderfälle im Detail.

  • Hohe Reisebereitschaft mitbringst und flexibel regelmäßig vor Ort bei unseren Verwaltungen in ganz Deutschland arbeitest.

  • Probleme vor Ort schnell analysierst, Prioritäten setzt und ohne Berührungsängste selbst mit anpackst.

  • Empathisch und klar kommunizierst, schnell Vertrauen bei bestehenden Teams aufbaust und Menschen für neue, digitale Arbeitsweisen gewinnst.

  • Tech-affin bist und komplexe Software schnell durchdringst, um sie anderen einfach zu erklären.

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau sprichst.

Deine Benefits

  • Bis zu 500 € Close-to-Office-Bonus, wenn du 10 bis 20 Gehminuten vom Büro entfernt wohnst.

  • 110 €/Monat Lunch-Budget, 50 € Fitness-Zuschuss.

  • 1.200 € jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget.

  • Kostenlose Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen möchtest.

Warum jetzt einsteigen

  • Du bist die Schlüsselperson vor Ort: Mit über 90.000 Einheiten und 30+ übernommenen Verwaltungen wachsen wir schnell. Jede neue Hausverwaltung wird erst durch dich zu einem echten Buena-Betrieb.

  • Wir sind meritokratisch: Wer liefert, bekommt schnell große Verantwortung. Unser CEO war vor drei Jahren Junior Product Manager, unser COO vor zwei Jahren Chief of Staff.

  • Echter Impact: Die deutsche Hausverwaltung läuft vielerorts noch auf Papier und Excel. Du stellst das vor Ort auf moderne Technologie um.

Hi, we’re AMBOSS and we’re searching for a Legal Counsel to support our business in IT & Data Protection matters!

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we've grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town.

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique

Why can this position be exciting for you?

In this role, you will be the core link between regulatory requirements and day-to-day operations. By partnering in early stages with product and engineering teams, you turn complex privacy rules – including emerging AI frameworks – into straightforward, actionable guidance that keeps projects moving forward & safely. From streamlining vendor reviews and data subject requests to mapping risks across our systems, your work lead to practical processes, ensuring AMBOSS expands into new markets with scalable compliance already built in.

You will:

  • Be a trusted data protection advisor for our teams. You partner with product and engineering from concept to launch, including on [AI-based features / new markets]. You give clear, pragmatic recommendations.

  • Own data protection risk assessment across our systems and processes. You identify, assess and prioritise compliance risks and turn them into practical frameworks that teams can use.

  • Keep us ahead of international requirements. You track data protection and related regulation in our markets, including AI-related rules, and turn them into pragmatic solutions for AMBOSS.

  • Make vendors, tools and contracts easy to get right. You review and negotiate data processing agreements and assess new software and vendors, so the business gets fast, reliable answers.

  • Build and improve our data protection operations. You own our policies, the record of processing activities and the handling of data subject requests (access, rectification, erasure). You simplify, standardise and automate wherever possible.

  • Work as one team. You collaborate closely with our DPO, the General Counsel and the wider Legal team, and bring in external input when it makes sense.

You bring:

  • Legal qualification (Diploma; 1st state exam, LLM or international equivalent)

  • At least 4 years of experience in IT law and data protection at a law firm or in-house, with a clear track record of giving practical, decision-ready advice to a diverse range of stakeholders

  • Strong working knowledge of GDPR and how to apply it pragmatically in a product environment

  • Prior experience working alongside engineering, product, and technical teams to translate complex legal, regulatory, and compliance requirements into actionable product features, technical specifications, and workflows

  • Technical curiosity: you enjoy understanding how systems and data flows work

  • A pragmatic interest in AI and legal technology, and ideally experience using these tools to work faster and more effectively

You enjoy:

  • A diverse Legal Portfolio: Drive a fast-evolving mix of IT legal matters, data protection frameworks, and commercial advisory

  • Uncharted legal territory: High-stakes regulatory challenges and emerging tech questions where the playbook hasn't been written yet

  • High autonomy, real impact: Move past "no" to craft actionable, business-enabling solutions with complete ownership of your domain

  • Continuous Improvement: Disrupt outdated legal workflows and refine our operational baseline for scale

  • A humorous and high-performing team :)

Benefits:

AMBOSSians tell us that innovative work keeps them energized and employee benefits help them to feel appreciated and empowered. We invest in every AMBOSSian with our employee benefits package, crafted to support financial, physical, and mental health, and work-life harmony.

🌴 Rest & Time Off (30 paid vacation days, AMBOSS holiday, personal purpose day and more)

🥙Food & Office Comfort (Daily healthy breakfast & lunch by in-house chef in Berlin HQ, AMBOSS daycare, work remotely from other office spaces in Cologne, Sardinia, Cape Town)

🏃 Health, Fitness & Mobility (Urban Sports Club -M plan- , Fitbit Versa 3, Deutschland Ticket…)

Check out the full list of benefits below:

https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de

That’s why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyone—regardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity—is valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfil our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care 🩺

About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

About the role

Andercore runs global trade end to end, from sourcing and pricing to sales, logistics and financing, and AI agents do a growing share of that work. Order values are high and prices and stock change daily, so the systems underneath have to be fast, correct and reliable at all times.

As a Staff Engineer, you own our hardest technical problems and set the architecture across teams. You focus on what a fast-growing trading business cannot afford to get wrong: speed, reliability, security and observability. You report to our VP Engineering and work closely with our Senior Product Engineers, QA and product managers. You stay hands-on: you write code, review designs and raise the bar for everyone around you

Tech stack

Java 21 and Spring Boot 3, Python, LangGraph and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), PostgreSQL, Kinesis, AWS with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and TypeScript with Node.js, Next.js and React. Including Salesforce, which we are moving our transaction core out of.

 

What you will do

  • Set the technical direction across teams: define the target architecture, write the RFCs behind big decisions, and make sure teams build towards the same picture.

  • Lead the hardest technical work yourself, from design to production, instead of only advising on it.

  • Shape the carve-out of our transaction core from Salesforce into a modern, modular core system, with a migration path that never disrupts daily trading.

  • Make reliability, security and observability part of how we build: monitoring, alerting, incident response and postmortems that lead to real changes.

  • Design how our AI agents act safely on money-touching paths, with evaluations, guardrails, audit trails and human review where it matters.

  • Set standards for correctness and data integrity, including idempotency, validation and testing, together with QA.

  • Mentor engineers through design reviews, pairing and direct feedback, and help us hire by defining what great engineering looks like at Andercore.

 

In your first six months, you might

  • Design the architecture of our pricing engine so it scales with a growing assortment and more markets, and serves correct prices to sales, and later directly to customers, in milliseconds.

  • Lay out the target architecture and first steps for moving our transaction core off Salesforce.

  • Build the observability and incident setup that lets us catch problems before customers or colleagues notice them

     

What you bring

  • At least 8 years of experience building and running software in production, including systems where errors cost real money.

  • Deep backend expertise at production scale in Java or a comparable language such as Kotlin, C# or Go, and willingness to work in Java and Spring Boot.

  • A track record of setting architecture across several teams, through influence rather than a management title.

  • Experience designing transactional, distributed and event-driven systems, with a strong focus on correctness, failure modes and performance.

  • Hands-on depth in reliability, security and observability, and experience leading incidents and postmortems.

  • Experience in a fast-growing company, and a track record of solving business problems, not only technical ones.

  • AI is part of your daily work. Experience building or evaluating AI agents in production is a strong plus.

  • Experience with re-platforming or carving out systems from a platform like Salesforce or an ERP is a plus

 

Practical details

  • Location: Berlin, hybrid

  • Working language: English

  • A learning budget for your development

  • Start date: As soon as possible

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

Growth Consultant (m/w/d), Account Management für 30 bis 40 B2B Tech Kunden in Berlin

Die meisten Account-Management-Jobs heißen Beratung und bestehen am Ende aus Reporting-Decks und Ticket-Pingpong. Hier ist es umgekehrt: Die Umsetzung macht das Team, du berätst.

Unser Kunde ist eine AI-first GTM Agentur aus Berlin Mitte. Seit 2024 auf über 5 Mio. EUR ARR und 30+ Leute gewachsen, mit 200+ B2B Tech Kunden, von der Mobility-App über einen Schweizer Telko-Konzern bis zum Bildungsverlag. Zuletzt kam in einem einzigen Monat über 1 Mio. EUR neuer ARR dazu.

Jeder dieser Kunden braucht jemanden, der ihn hält und ausbaut. Genau dafür ist dieser Seat da.

Das Paket: 50 bis 70k EUR Fix plus 12,5% Provision auf Upsell und Retention, Berlin Mitte, 3 Tage Office und 2 Tage remote.

Tasks

  • Du führst dein eigenes Portfolio aus ca. 30 bis 40 Accounts und sitzt alle zwei Wochen mit Geschäftsführern und Entscheidern im Termin.

  • Deine Kunden sind B2B Software- und Tech-Firmen, die über Google, LinkedIn, Meta und signalbasiertes Outbound ihre Pipeline aufbauen. Insgesamt laufen jeden Monat sechsstellige Budgets in Paid Search und Paid Social über die Agentur.

  • Der typische Moment: Ein Geschäftsführer, der viel Geld in Ads und Outbound steckt, fragt dich, warum seine Leads teurer geworden sind und ob er das Budget kürzen soll. Du hast die Antwort und den nächsten Schritt.

  • Beratung statt Operatives: Kampagnen bauen die GTM- und Performance-Marketing-Teams. Du entscheidest mit dem Kunden, was als Nächstes gebaut wird.

  • Upsell und Retention sind dein Hebel: neuer Kanal, mehr Budget, Verlängerung. Dein Spielfeld ist das bestehende Portfolio.

  • Du liest die Zahlen deiner Accounts (Leads, Cost per Lead, Pipeline) und siehst ein Abwanderungsrisiko, bevor der Kunde es ausspricht.

Requirements

  • Ein paar Jahre B2B mit echter, eigener Kundenverantwortung. Ob als Account Manager, BDM, kommerzielles Customer Success, AE mit Bestandskunden oder Founder’s Associate, der Titel ist egal. Interne Koordination oder reines Projektmanagement zählt hier nicht.

  • Du erzählst deinen Track Record in Zahlen: wie viele Accounts, welche Retention, wie viel Upsell-Volumen.

  • Wenn dir ein Geschäftsführer im Call sagt, die Leads taugen nichts und er überlegt zu kündigen, gehst du in die Daten statt in die Defensive und kommst mit einem Plan raus.

  • Du hältst 30+ Kunden parallel auf dem Schirm, ohne dass einer durchrutscht, und baust dir dafür dein eigenes System.

  • Du brauchst niemanden, der dir den Tag plant. Du siehst die Lücke und schließt sie.

  • Idealerweise hast du Outbound, Lead Gen oder B2B-Akquise schon selbst gemacht. Pluspunkte: Google oder LinkedIn Ads, CRM, Agentur-, Consulting- oder Startup-Background.

  • Fix: Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, gutes Englisch, Festanstellung in Vollzeit, 3 Tage pro Woche im Berliner Office (der erste Monat komplett vor Ort).

  • Early Career bis Mid. Gesucht ist Hunger, nicht Seniorität: Wer seit Jahren Senior Advisory macht, wird hier nicht glücklich. Ein Abschluss oder ein großes Logo im Lebenslauf sind nicht das Tor, deine Zahlen schon.

Benefits

  • 50 bis 70k EUR Fix plus 12,5% Provision auf Upsell und Retention. Du verdienst also auch daran, dass Kunden bleiben, nicht nur an neuen Deals.

Team Lead Sales Development (m/w/d), Player-Coach für 5 bis 8 SDRs bei einer Sales-as-a-Service Agentur in Berlin

Intro

Die meisten Teamlead-Rollen suchen jemanden, der Dashboards anschaut. Hier sieht dein Team dich selbst telefonieren.

Unser Kunde baut und betreibt B2B Outbound für Firmen, die kein eigenes Sales-Team aufbauen können oder wollen. Sales-as-a-Service aus Kreuzberg, 20+ Leute aus Sales und KI, backed by einem Health-VC und einem Berliner Family Office. Dazu eigene KI-Modelle auf eigenen Daten und Elite-Partner eines großen Cloud-Telefonie-Anbieters.

Die Mandate reichen vom Weltkonzern bis zum Stealth-Startup, dazu US-Firmen beim Markteintritt in Deutschland. Die Teamlead-Rolle hat gerade höchste Priorität.

Das Paket: 60k EUR Fix, OTE bis 100k, Bonus ungedeckelt, Berlin hybrid ohne starre Office-Policy.

Tasks

  • Du führst ein Team von 5 bis 8 SDRs, das für Kunden Termine bucht. Rund 70% Führung: Coaching, Call-Reviews, Kampagnensteuerung, Reporting.

  • Rund 30% operativ: Du bleibst selbst am Telefon und springst rein, wo es brennt.

  • Die Mandate: Smart Building und Gebäudetechnik, KI-Softwareentwicklung, Fördermittel, Deep Tech, Sondermaschinenbau, Stadtwerke, internationale Sales-Tech-Plattformen.

  • Du hast täglich Kundenkontakt, auch mit CEOs und Head ofs. Der typische Moment: Ein CEO, der für Outbound bezahlt, will wissen, warum diese Woche weniger Termine kamen als geplant. Du erklärst es mit Zahlen und verkaufst den nächsten Schritt.

  • Eigene Kundenprojekte: Du setzt neue Mandate auf (ICP, Liste, Messaging, Kadenz) und richtest das Team darauf aus. Internationale Projekte wie US-Markteintritte landen oft genau bei den Teamleads.

  • Du steuerst über Calls, Connect Rate, Meetings und Show Rate pro SDR und weißt, an welchem Hebel du drehst.

  • Stack: Clay, Lemlist, n8n, Attio, Placetel, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, plus eine eigene KI-Unit mit automatisierter Recherche und KI-Call-Coaching.

Requirements

  • Du warst selbst SDR und hast kalt telefoniert. Du weißt, wie sich der 60. Call am Tag anfühlt, und genau daher kommt deine Glaubwürdigkeit als Coach.

  • Mindestens 1 Jahr echte Führungserfahrung als Teamlead im B2B. Reines B2C reicht hier nicht.

  • Wenn ein SDR seit Wochen unter Ziel liegt, hast du einen Plan: Call-Review, Roleplay, 1:1, und wenn nötig auch die Konsequenz.

  • Vor einem CEO bleibst du ruhig, klar und hast die Zahlen parat, gerade in einer schlechten Woche.

  • Nicht für alles gibt es einen Prozess. Du baust mit, statt dich an Zuständigkeiten festzuhalten.

  • Fix: fließend Deutsch, Wohnort Berlin.

  • Ehrlich gesagt: Wenn du heute Head of bist und dieses Level halten willst, ist das eine Ebene zu tief. Und wer nur noch steuern und nicht mehr telefonieren will, ist hier falsch. Ein Abschluss oder ein großes Logo im Lebenslauf sind nicht das Tor, deine Team-Zahlen schon.

Benefits

  • 60k EUR Fix, OTE bis 100k, Bonus ungedeckelt. Das Fixum ist bewusst moderat, der Bonus ist der Hebel für alle, die mit ihrem Team Leistung bringen wollen.

  • Perspektive: mehr Verantwortung über eigene Kundenprojekte und größere Teams, Richtung Project Lead mit Verantwortung für Kundenaccounts und SDR-Teams.

  • Lernkurve: Mandate quer durch Branchen, vom Konzern bis zum Stealth-Startup, plus internationale Markteintritte. Nach 12 Monaten setzt du ein Outbound-Projekt in jeder Branche von null auf und bringst ein Team darauf.

  • Coaching mit Daten statt Bauchgefühl: KI-Recherche und KI-Call-Coaching aus der hauseigenen KI-Unit machen deine SDRs schneller besser.

  • Hybrid ohne starre Policy: Office am Moritzplatz, viel Präsenz ist erwünscht, ein Monat von woanders ist in der Regel drin.

  • Junges Team im Startup-Modus, in dem alle noch selbst reinspringen, auch die Gründer.

Closing

Klingt nach dir? Die Bewerbung dauert zwei Minuten, kein Motivationsschreiben.

So läuft’s: Bewerbung ➝ Talent Call mit uns ➝ ca. 30 Min Screening digital ➝ Fachgespräch zu Führung und Praxis, voraussichtlich mit Cold Call oder Führungs-Case ➝ Meet the Team vor Ort in Berlin, das Team hat Veto ➝ Entscheidung und Offer.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world, processing 25+ trillion data points annually across thousands of connected devices. The Samsara Application Security team protects this vast footprint end-to-end, spanning cloud services, internal systems, and firmware running on IoT hardware in the field.

As a Staff Application Security Engineer, you'll drive the overarching technical direction for our application security and vulnerability management programs. This is a high-visibility role where you'll influence a broad surface area while retaining the flexibility to dive deep into critical domain focus areas as security priorities evolve.

This is a remote position, open to candidates residing in the UK. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, and countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will: 

  • Lead the ongoing strategy, operation, and continuous improvement of Samsara's vulnerability management program, along with other core application security programs — not just execute against an existing process, but define what the process should be.
  • Own and drive down mean time to remediate (MTTR) across the vulnerability backlog, as SLAs tighten.
  • Build and champion automation and tooling that scale vulnerability detection and response across cloud, firmware/IoT, and corporate systems, rather than relying on manual, one-by-one review.
  • Set technical and architectural direction for the program, translating leadership's strategic priorities into a concrete execution plan for the team.
  • Drive remediation by building trust with engineering teams and providing clear, actionable guidance — partnering with technical program management on reporting rather than owning it directly.
  • Mentor and level up other engineers on secure design and remediation practices, and be a technical voice other teams look to when priorities are unclear.
  • Communicate risk and remediation tradeoffs to engineering leadership in terms they can act on, without owning the relationship end to end.
  • Participate in security incident investigations involving high-profile vulnerabilities, assessing potential impact on Samsara's infrastructure.
  • Be regularly on call to support critical vulnerability response.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience as a cloud engineer or security engineer, including hands-on vulnerability management across a broad, multi-product enterprise environment  — not a single product or team's slice of it.
  • Proficiency in Go, Python, and JavaScript.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently set technical and architectural direction for a security program, and to drive remediation across a broad, multi-surface environment without direct authority over the teams doing the fixing.
  • Significant experience with modern vulnerability management tooling (e.g., Wiz, Semgrep) and deep familiarity with vulnerability scoring frameworks such as CVSS and EPSS.
  • Strong AWS cloud services background.
  • Deep understanding of Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), and Software Composition Analysis (SCA).
  • Hands-on use of AI/LLM tooling in your own security workflow — triage, detection logic, remediation drafting — plus credibility speaking to how AI is changing the threat landscape and the tooling available to address it.
  • Location: must be based in central or eastern timezones.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience with C/C++, relevant to firmware and embedded systems.
  • Background at a cloud-native, AI-forward company actively building agentic or AI-driven products.
  • Experience with security automation platforms (e.g., Tines) and serverless frameworks (e.g., AWS Lambda).
  • Experience integrating vulnerability management into modern CI/CD pipelines with a "shift-left" mentality.
  • Experience spanning SaaS, firmware, and corporate IT security programs — not just one product line.
  • Experience managing vulnerabilities within a FedRAMP-certified environment.
  • Experience building, extending, or wiring up AI copilots/agents for security workflows (e.g., automated triage, remediation drafting).

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the role

UFORCE is looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to help build and operate the cloud infrastructure platform behind our sovereign mission operations teams. You’ll make it safer and easier to deploy, upgrade, and run UFORCE services in on-premises environments, including sites with limited or no internet connectivity.

You’ll combine hands-on infrastructure engineering with practical operational ownership: automating deployments, strengthening reliability, and making sure customer IT and partner operations teams can run the platform with confidence. You’ll work closely with Platform Engineering, Security, and customer-facing teams, with a focus on solutions that are secure, supportable, and usable in the field.

What you’ll do

  • Build and improve deployment and maintenance automation for on-premises environments, including infrastructure as code, packaging, environment validation, and preflight checks.
