data.description:
About Nous

Nous is a household AI agent. It takes over the bills and admin people don't have time for and acts for them: switching energy, buying insurance, cancelling forgotten subscriptions, managing the family calendar. Nearly 250,000 UK households have signed up, and another joins every minute.

We think the real value of AI isn't writing amazing cover letters, it's doing useful things in the real world for real people. That's the hard part, and a brilliant product is only half of it. An energy switch takes weeks, so our agents run on long-running workflows, not a single chat turn. Cancelling a subscription means a browser agent handling the code Apple sends to your phone. Buying insurance meant getting our regulatory principal comfortable with an agent doing it end to end (a UK first), which comes down to knowing exactly when the LLM should hand over to rules because a mistake would cost someone real money.

We're about 30 people running one agent across energy, broadband, mobile, insurance, mortgages and subscriptions (with more being added), each with its own suppliers, rules and ways of going wrong. With far more problems than people, a person or small team owns each one end to end, from spotting it in the data or a customer conversation to shipping the fix. And because the agent acts, you find out quickly whether the fix worked.

Everyone builds here: a product engineer launched our subscription cancellation product within a couple of months of joining, and a PM rebuilt our WhatsApp agent.

And it's working. We're growing more than 20x year on year, with a market-leading NPS above +80, and we manage well over half a billion pounds of household spending. We've raised more than $30M from Heartcore, Mosaic and a who's who of entrepreneurs who founded Monzo, GoCardless, lastminute.com and Onfido. But the real draw is the team - ask anyone here why they joined and you'll get some version of "to do great work with really smart people".

The goal is household life that's simpler, cheaper and fairer, and most of that is still to build.

The role

What Nous does for members can feel simple: helping them understand their bills, save money, and avoid admin. Delivering that reliably at scale is much harder.

You’ll join the Operations team at the heart of the business, working on the difficult real-world problems that sit between our members, our product, external suppliers and the systems that make Nous work.

This is not a traditional customer operations role. You’ll spend time close to our members, understanding their questions, investigating things that have gone wrong and learning in detail how our service works. We think that matters: the best systems are usually built by people who have seen the underlying problems first-hand.

But we don’t want you simply to get faster at doing manual work. We want you to spot the pattern, understand why the problem exists, and help build a better way of doing it.

That might mean redesigning a process, building an automation, using AI to remove repetitive work, querying data to understand what is happening, improving an internal tool, or working with Product and Engineering on a more fundamental fix.

You don't need to arrive knowing all of the tools we use. We care much more about how quickly you learn them.

We’re looking for someone early in their career who is unusually curious, quick to learn and good at figuring things out. You might already have built automations or small products yourself. You might instead have worked in operations, consulting, product, analytics or another demanding environment and found yourself constantly looking for better ways to do things.

Either way, we want someone who gets excited by a problem they don't immediately know how to solve.

You’ll have a lot of support from experienced operators, engineers and product people, but also be given a lot of responsibility unusually early in your career. The aim is for you to quickly become someone who can take an undefined operational problem, understand it properly and build a robust solution.

It’s a rare chance to learn how a fast-growing technology company actually works from the inside while building the systems that allow it to scale.

 

About you

You’re smart, curious, ambitious and unusually high-agency.

You don't need a long list of technical tools on your CV. We care much more about how you think, how quickly you learn and what you do when you encounter something you don't understand.

You’ll probably thrive here if you:

  • Have roughly 1–3 years of experience in a demanding environment such as a startup, operations, consulting, product, analytics or similar

  • Learn unusually quickly and enjoy tackling problems you haven't seen before

  • Are technically curious and actively experiment with AI and new tools to make yourself more effective

  • Have evidence that you like building things, whether that's automations, side projects, spreadsheets, scripts, internal tools, processes or something completely different

  • Are comfortable getting into the detail and tracing a problem until you understand what is really happening

  • Can take something messy and ambiguous and impose structure on it

  • Are naturally empathetic and enjoy understanding what a customer actually needs

  • Communicate clearly and directly

  • Are comfortable working directly with customers and frontline problems, and see that as a source of insight

  • Take ownership rather than waiting to be told exactly what to do

This role is ideal for someone early in their career who wants a steep learning curve, real responsibility and the chance to work as part of a team solving difficult problems.

About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

data.description:
Tired of being told “that’s not your scope”?

Plenty of good analysts hit the same wall: you query the data but never build the pipelines, you’re boxed into one lane, and more scope means waiting your turn. Here, it’s the opposite.

Taptap Send moves billions of dollars a month across 6 of 7 continents. We’re probably the largest, fastest-growing money movement business you’ve never heard of. Cards, wallets, business-to-business payments, institutional payments, and new markets are all launching now, and each needs its data, reconciliations and reporting built from scratch. That’s your work.

The job

You’ll own the external reports the business can’t operate without, then automate them into reliable, reusable dbt models. From day one you’ll work with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product and Data Engineering to make sure every number is modelled correctly.

  • Own external reporting: deliver the datasets behind month-end close and regulatory reporting, on time, every cycle.

  • Automate: turn multi-day manual work into scheduled pipelines, runbooks and dbt models, so it only gets done once.

  • Get ahead of launches: build reports and reconciliations as each product and market goes live, before anyone asks.

  • Be first line for data requests: build models so people and AI agents can answer repeat questions themselves.

  • Keep data trustworthy: build tests, checks and alerts that catch reconciliation breaks and stale data before they become incidents.

  • Share what you know: peer-review code and join our weekly meetups.

Why you’ll want it

Grow as fast as you’re able. We hire for potential, not years of experience. On a lean, talent-dense team, you’ll own real work early and take on more the moment you’re ready.

Go from querying data to designing systems. Data, product or business analyst? You don’t need to be an analytics engineer yet. Build the pipelines behind the numbers, and learn dbt, testing, automation and AI tooling from senior analytics engineers.

Don't get boxed in. Own the reporting, automate it, then take on our biggest problems wherever they sit. Your hiring manager started in Finance and has since worked across Partner Ops, Fraud, Compliance, Reconciliation and Product.

See the whole business. You’ll follow a transfer from the moment a customer taps send, through partner payout and reconciliation, to the report a regulator reads.

Own numbers that matter. Auditors and Finance rely on what you build. This isn’t a dashboard role.

Put more money in families’ hands. Remittances are a lifeline for millions of families and are worth more than all foreign aid. Every report you automate helps us keep transfers cheap and reliable.

You’ll fit if you have

  • 1-2+ years in a data or analytics role

  • A technical or quantitative degree, or equivalent experience

  • Strong SQL and experience wrangling messy, complex data

  • Some experience automating repetitive work (e.g. scripts, scheduled jobs)

  • A strong sense of ownership: when something is broken, ownerless or late, you step in, fix it, and make sure it doesn’t happen again

  • Reliability under deadlines, a “no task too small” attitude, and comfort chasing stakeholders

  • The right to work in the UK

Nice to have: startup or scale-up experience, Python or R, dbt, Looker or Mode, and something you’ve built, at work or on the side, because the manual way annoyed you.

Sound like you? Apply, even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to meet you.

V7

At V7, we’re building AI platforms that help humans do their best work, at incredible scale and speed. Our mission is to turn human knowledge into trustworthy AI, making complex tasks faster, smarter, and more accurate. We’re growing fast, backed by leading investors and AI pioneers (including the minds behind Transformers and Gemini).

The team you'll be joining and impact you'll have

  • You'll own how V7 looks and feels to the world, across both the marketing site and the product itself. This is a product and brand design role first: you'll be setting the visual direction, designing the product experience and making sure the two hang together.

  • Our design team is small and sits close to engineering. Designers here work directly with the people building the product, and the loop between a design decision and it appearing in the codebase is short.

  • A lot of this currently sits with contractors or is spread thinly across the team. You'll pull it in-house and become the person who owns the brand and the product's design language.

  • You'll help shape our design system and the front-end refactor that sits underneath it, defining the components and patterns everyone else builds on. Engineering will do the heavy lifting on implementation, but you'll be the one deciding what good looks like.

What you'll be doing from day one:

  • Own the marketing site end to end in Framer, including the parts most people skip: CMS collections, dynamic content, responsive behaviour and interaction states.

  • Design product UI against our design system, from early exploration through to polished, buildable specs, working alongside engineers rather than throwing designs over the wall.

  • Define motion and interaction: animation, empty and loading states, transitions, and the detail that makes a product feel finished. Where it's quicker to tweak it yourself in the codebase, you can.

  • Take on genuinely new surfaces that don't have a pattern yet, like visualising the Context Graph: nodes, edges, and how a knowledge graph should actually read on screen.

  • Run an AI-first workflow: exploring variants in Claude Design, generating specs in Cursor, using whatever tooling gets you from idea to something real fastest. Fast because of the tooling, not despite it.

Who you are

  • You're a product and brand designer with real craft. Your portfolio shows strong visual instincts and thoughtful product thinking, and you can hold a coherent direction across web, marketing and product.

  • You know Framer properly, CMS collections and all, and you can build a page that looks good and reads well without hand-holding, with the kind of animation and polish that lifts a brand.

  • You can work inside a design system: extending components, keeping things consistent, and knowing when something genuinely needs a new pattern versus reusing what's there.

  • You're comfortable enough around code that opening a pull request in Cursor or similar to fix a spacing issue or adjust a component doesn't scare you. That's a bonus, not the job. You're a designer who can get hands-on when it helps, not an engineer who happens to design.

  • You treat AI tooling as core to how you work, using it to amplify your output and move faster rather than keeping it at arm's length.

V7 champions equality and inclusion because diverse teams build better products. Don't check every box? Apply anyway — we value what makes you unique and will support you through the process, just let our Talent team know how they can help.

Compensation: £70K – £100K • Offers Equity

About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

We’re looking for a full-stack Python engineer to join our Central Operations team.

Central Ops sits across our core products (Cards, Loans and Motor), focusing on shared operational challenges and opportunities. We build a mix of internally facing web applications and robust automations to help our Operations teams deliver great outcomes for customers, efficiently and at scale.

It’s a broad space: Operations makes up roughly half of our employee headcount and covers everything from day-to-day customer support up to complex areas like Fraud and Fincrime prevention. As our customer base grows rapidly, our role is to help ops keep pace without relying solely on headcount growth. We make intelligent, pragmatic use of AI where it adds real value, working closely with Product, Data Science and Analytics to deploy solutions that genuinely support our ops agents.

You’ll have real ownership from an engineering perspective, shipping features that are used daily by Ops teams. It’s an evolving space at Lendable, and what you build will help shape both our tools and our technical direction.

Some examples of things we’ve built recently:

  • Rebuilt our Ops QA admin system from the ground up, replacing an off-the-shelf tool with something tailored to our needs

  • Deployed a pipeline to summarise customer calls into concise notes using LLMs, automatically surfaced in ops admin panels — removing the need for manual note-writing

  • More than doubled the number of complaints processed by agents through a combination of targeted AI automation and improved UX

 

What we’re looking for

We’d consider the following essential to the role:

  • You have 8+ years of professional experience as a software engineer

  • Solid experience with Python in a web application context. You have some experience with web frameworks like FastAPI, Django or Flask. We use FastAPI.

  • Experience with Javascript/Typescript and a modern JS framework such as React, Angular or Vue.js. We generally use React & NextJS. You can build a frontend that's good enough for internal tooling

  • Strong engineering principles & practices: design patterns, testing, clean code and a good reviewer

  • Previous experience working in a product-focused team

  • A keen desire to want to learn and input into a highly collaborative team

  • You use AI tools like Copilot, Cursor, Claude or others in your day-to-day coding

 

The following are also a plus, but by no means essential. If you don’t meet all of these, please apply anyway!

  • Exposure to Domain Driven Design, Message-Driven Systems and Event Sourcing

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS

  • SQL, and finding your way around data schemas

  • Shipping containerised software with Argo, Kubernetes, Docker and Terraform

Interview process

  • A 30 minute introductory call

  • Take Home Task

  • Technical Interview

  • Cultural/behavioural interview

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Lemonway est un établissement de paiement agréé, au cœur de la nouvelle économie européenne.

Nous sécurisons les paiements des plateformes de financement participatif, d’économie collaborative, des marketplaces et des e-commerçants, avec un fort engagement contre la fraude et pour la protection des fonds.

Réglementée par l’ACPR et bénéficiant du passeport européen dans 29 pays, Lemonway est basée à Paris et Hambourg et rassemble 150 Lemonheroes multiculturels et engagés.

Plus de 400 marketplaces nous font confiance. Nous gérons 1,4 million de portefeuilles utilisateurs et avons levé 50 M€ auprès de Breega, SpeedInvest et Toscafund.

Rentable depuis quatre ans et en croissance de +25 % en 2025, Lemonway vise à rester parmi les leaders du paiement en Europe grâce à une croissance saine et durable.

  • Secteur : FinTech / Paiements en ligne

  • Localisation : Paris, France (Quartier du Sentier, 2e arrondissement)

Le rôle

Au sein de notre équipe Alternative Finance Sales, vous contribuerez à renforcer l’efficacité des activités commerciales, de la préparation des campagnes de prospection à la structuration des données et des outils Sales.

Ce stage vous permettra de jouer un rôle actif dans le développement commercial de Lemonway, en participant à l’identification de nouvelles opportunités, au mapping de comptes stratégiques et à la préparation de campagnes de prospection ciblées.

Vous découvrirez progressivement l’ensemble du cycle de vente, avec l’opportunité de participer aux rendez-vous commerciaux et de contribuer concrètement aux différentes étapes du développement de nos activités.

  • Mettre à jour et fiabiliser les données dans Salesforce.

  • Réaliser des recherches de marché et une veille concurrentielle sur les paiements et la FinTech.

  • Identifier des opportunités d’automatisation et contribuer à la création d’outils utilisant l’intelligence artificielle.

  • Préparer des supports commerciaux et participer ponctuellement à des rendez-vous.

  • Les fondamentaux du Business Development et de la prospection B2B.

  • La construction de campagnes commerciales ciblées.

  • L’utilisation d’un CRM et d’outils de prospection.

  • Les enjeux du marché des paiements et de la finance alternative.

  • Les applications concrètes de l’automatisation et de l’intelligence artificielle dans les activités commerciales.


Vous êtes en dernière année d’école de commerce, d’université ou d’une formation en commerce, marketing, finance, stratégie, data ou technologie, et vous recherchez un stage de fin d’études.

Nous recherchons avant tout une personne :

  • Curieuse, volontaire et désireuse d’apprendre.

  • Intéressée par la vente B2B, la FinTech, les paiements et les nouvelles technologies.

We are looking for someone to join us as an early member of the Web team, to build and own web platforms that turn large amounts of data into products people love to use. Maps and location data sit at the core of what we build, and we’re looking for an engineer who can take a platform from data model to pixel.

In the initial months, you’ll work closely with the team, gradually taking ownership of central systems and features. Given our stage, we’re seeking versatile engineers comfortable contributing across the frontend, the backend and the data.

We value team members who delve deep into their respective domains, aiming to cultivate a team of subject matter experts with a high sense of ownership. This commitment to expertise is an expectation for every team member.

As a Web Engineer, your day-to-day will include:

Platform Engineering

Designing and building robust, scalable web platforms end-to-end in TypeScript: APIs, services, data access layers and the UI on top of them. You’ll make the architectural decisions and set the patterns that others build on.

Workflows & Data Pipelines

Architecting durable, long-running workflows and background processes on our workflow orchestration system (Restate). You’ll also build the pipelines that move data between our warehouse, our databases and our products, reliably and at scale.

Data Modeling & Visualization

Modeling large datasets so they can be queried and visualized fast. That includes choosing the right aggregations, pre-computations and storage across Postgres and BigQuery, and turning them into visualizations that are clear, interactive and beautiful. You’ll handle data with privacy in mind from the very first design decision.

Maps & Geospatial Data

Bringing geospatial data to life on the web. You’ll render large amounts of location data on interactive maps, and keep them as fast and polished as they are insightful.

Roadmap Creation and Ideation

Contributing actively to the roadmap: identifying the right tradeoffs and bringing ideas from both a product and an engineering perspective.

Owning your scope

You’ll be responsible for the architecture, performance, monitoring and reliability of everything you ship. We value engineers who take full ownership of their scope, and who proactively address issues before anyone asks.


Your Skills & Experience:

Please indicate your years of experience on the application form.

  • 7+ years of professional experience building SaaS products or data-heavy platforms.

  • High proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js, and in modern web frameworks (React, Next.js…).

  • Strong experience with Postgres and data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar).

  • Solid understanding of data modeling for analytics and for visualizing large volumes of data.

  • A privacy-aware approach to handling sensitive data, such as aggregation and anonymization.

  • Comfortable working autonomously across frontend and backend.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration and long-running processes (Restate, Temporal, or similar) is a big plus.

  • Expertise in map rendering and geospatial data visualization (Mapbox GL, MapLibre, deck.gl, or similar) is a big plus.

  • Experience with WebGL or GPU rendering is a plus.

  • Comfortable working closely with backend and data teams across a polyglot stack is a plus.

  • Knowledge of infrastructure (Bazel, GCP, Kubernetes) is a plus.

  • Passion and experience building great products. We’d love to hear about things you’ve shipped!

AI as a multiplier

AI is part of how we build every day. We’re looking for engineers with a real grasp of these tools, who use them to multiply their output and not to make up for missing expertise. You should be able to drive an agent through a complex change, judge what it produces, spot where it’s subtly wrong, and stand behind every line that ships.

The bar

We’re looking for exceptional engineers, and we set the bar high on purpose. In return, you’ll get real ownership from day one, products used by millions of people, a team that ships in days rather than quarters, a modern stack with top-tier tooling, and colleagues who will push you to grow.

You don’t need to speak French to apply (and you don’t need perfect English; we’ll help you ramp up quickly).

Life at amo:

To ensure that everyone is set up for success within our way of working, we work together onsite 5 days a week.

We wanted to make sure coming to the office was as comfortable as possible for you:

  • We chose a location in central Paris, near Opera (Metro lines 3,8,9 and RER A).

  • We have a beautiful Parisian-style office with high ceilings, balconies, and huge windows. So a lot of natural light!

Because life outside of work should also be stress-free, we cover:

  • Health care (100% coverage).

  • Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Second Parent Leave (salary maintained at 100%).

  • Vacation days: 8-9 weeks (total) per year - (European summer? 🥹😎).

    • 5 weeks of paid time off (by the state);

    • 1-2 additional weeks (RTT, based on our company contract);

    • ~11 bank holidays.

We shut down entirely twice a year, two weeks in summer and one week in winter to allow everyone to truly recharge and to avoid prolonged slowdowns (especially in the summer). These pauses are part of your total vacation time, giving everyone a real chance to unplug and recharge. No Slack, no email, no FOMO.

Relocation

  • We love the diverse perspectives we get from having people from all over the world join us (68% of our team is international), and so we of course support relocation to Paris with:

  • Help and sponsored visa process.

  • 1 month of Airbnb 100% covered by amo upon arrival.

About Prelude

Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.

Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US.

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values

  • Care
    We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

  • Bias for Action
    We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory.

  • Ownership
    We take responsibility end to end, from identifying problems to delivering outcomes and learning from results.

About the Role

As a Mid-Market Account Executive, you'll be responsible for driving growth across one of Prelude’s most strategic segments: mid-sized businesses with high-scale authentication needs. You’ll own the full sales cycle, manage complex evaluations with multiple stakeholders, and partner closely with our technical teams to deliver high-impact solutions.

You’ll help shape our mid-market motion, refine our GTM strategy, and play a meaningful role in expanding Prelude’s footprint across Europe and beyond. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who has experience closing mid-market deals and wants to join a fast-growing startup where their impact is immediate and visible.

What will you be doing?

• Owning and managing the sales cycle for mid-market accounts, from outbound prospecting to contract execution.

• Building and maintaining a strong pipeline of high-value prospects across key verticals.

• Leading consultative discovery processes to understand customer needs, technical requirements, and decision criteria.

• Delivering high-quality demos and value-driven pitches tailored to mid-market use cases.

• Navigating multiple stakeholders — from product and engineering to procurement and legal.

• Consistently exceeding quota while maintaining healthy win rates and sales velocity.

• Delivering on cross-sell, up-sell and renewal opportunities

• Sharing insights from customer interactions to help refine product strategy, messaging, and positioning.

• Representing Prelude at industry events, conferences, and on-site customer meetings.

What are we looking for?

• Experience in B2B SaaS sales, including experience closing mid-market deals.

• A strong track record of achieving or exceeding quota.

• Confidence managing multi-stakeholder, multi-step sales processes

• Curiosity - you'll enjoy unpacking how products work under the hood.

• The ability to think strategically about accounts, to identify and engage economic buyers.

• Someone who will thrive in a fast-paced environment, who enjoys taking initiative.

• Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

• Fluency in English and French

• Enthusiasm for our product and potential

What we offer:

• Competitive salary with uncapped commission and generous BSPCEs.

• Hybrid working style: 4 days in-office, 1 day remote

• High-quality equipment and ergonomic setup.

• Annual company offsite (most recent was in the South of France).

• A close-knit, high-caliber team that prioritizes product excellence and customer success.

• Private healthcare.

• Pension scheme.

• Swile meal vouchers.

Interview Process

• A 30-minute call with our talent team to get to know each other.

• A 30-minute session with someone in the sales team to go deeper into the role.

• On-site interview at our Paris office, including a sales presentation and team meet-and-greet.

• A 1-hour meeting with our CEO to explore our strategy and long-term vision.

We believe conversations will become the #1 way to shop.

At Gorgias, we’re building the platform that makes this real: a unified AI agent that sells, supports, and re-engages customers across the entire journey. Conversational Commerce is the future of ecommerce, and we’re leading that shift.

Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. By combining deep product expertise with the latest in AI, we’re making shopping feel more natural, human, and connected than ever before.

To win, we focus relentlessly on:

  • Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand.

  • Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout.

  • Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing.

The opportunity is massive. As AI reshapes how people buy, Gorgias is building the foundation for the next decade of ecommerce, where every brand has its own intelligent agent and every customer feels understood.

Join us to make Conversational Commerce real.

About the Team

GTM Engineers builds the AI product layer for Gorgias's go-to-market teams: AI agents, internal cockpits, and the automations underneath them, all running on one shared context layer (Cortex). We work across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partnerships. We build and maintain the agents, the business teams own the outputs, and humans review exceptions.

About the Role

You'll own the AI agents that run Gorgias's GTM workflows, taking them from manual process to reviewed agent. The goal is to optimize as much GTM work as possible without losing quality. A strong fit ships working agents quickly, debugs a broken workflow in Cargo, HubSpot, or another GTM tool without waiting for help, and cares whether the business actually uses what gets built.

What You'll Do

About Orakl Oncology

Every cancer patient deserves a treatment that works for them. Today, too many never get one in time: fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs make it through clinical trials, and every failure costs patients precious time.

Orakl exists to change those odds.

We bridge biological and artificial intelligence by building large cohorts of virtual cancer patients, combining real patients' tumors with their medical histories and deep biological data. By integrating patient-derived tumor models, experimental biology and AI, we help pharmaceutical companies predict how cancer drugs will perform in patients, identify promising treatments and make better decisions earlier in drug development.

Founded in 2023 by Fanny Jaulin, PhD, Diane-Laure Pagès, PhD, and Gustave Ronteix, PhD, Orakl is a spin-out of Gustave Roussy, one of Europe's leading cancer centres, building on a decade of research. Backed by international investors, we are scaling our technology and partnerships with pharmaceutical companies worldwide.

Discover more at orakl-oncology.com

The role

We are looking for our first Communications, Brand & Events Lead to build Orakl's external presence from the ground up and establish the company as a leading voice in AI-driven cancer drug development. Your job is to make the world understand what we are building, why it matters and why Orakl is uniquely positioned to lead this transformation.

You will shape how Orakl is perceived by the pharmaceutical companies we partner with, the scientists we want to attract, the investors backing us and the broader industry. From defining our corporate narrative and building our reputation to securing media coverage and putting Orakl in the right rooms, you will turn our scientific and commercial progress into visibility, credibility and meaningful relationships.

You will own our communications, brand and events strategy, working directly with the founders and closely with our scientific, BD and Product Marketing teams. While Product Marketing focuses on our offerings and their commercial value, you will own Orakl's corporate voice, reputation and external presence. You will also lead internal events and support on internal brand alignment.

This is a strategic but highly hands-on role. You will set the direction, build the function and execute much of it yourself, with the autonomy to experiment, make decisions and shape how Orakl grows.

You will need to combine the speed and creativity of a startup with the standards of the pharmaceutical industry. Our communications must be distinctive and ambitious, but always grounded in scientific rigour, evidence and credibility.

What you'll do

Communications and brand: building Orakl's voice

  • Communications strategy. Define and execute Orakl's communications strategy across audiences, channels and markets, setting clear priorities that support the company's commercial, scientific, talent and fundraising ambitions.

  • Corporate positioning and narrative. Own Orakl's corporate story, key messages and tone of voice. Build a distinctive narrative around virtual patients and Orakl's role in advancing cancer drug development, ensuring consistency across the company.

  • Brand identity and presence. Own and evolve Orakl's brand identity and visual expression across the website, corporate materials, presentations and digital channels, working with designers and external partners when needed.

  • Content and editorial strategy. Build and manage an editorial calendar that turns Orakl's scientific breakthroughs, company milestones and industry perspectives into compelling content for the right audiences.

  • Founders' voice and thought leadership. Build the public profiles of Orakl's founders through LinkedIn, articles, op-eds, interviews and relevant scientific and industry channels. Identify the topics and conversations where Orakl can bring a distinctive perspective.

  • Press and media relations. Develop relationships with scientific, pharmaceutical, technology and business media. Identify newsworthy stories, pitch proactively and lead communications around funding, partnerships, scientific advances and company milestones.

  • Speaking opportunities. Build and pitch a targeted pipeline of speaking engagements, panels, podcasts and interviews that position Orakl's founders and scientific leaders as recognised voices in the industry.

  • Reputation and scientific credibility. Ensure all external communications are accurate, evidence-based and consistent with Orakl's scientific standards. Help manage sensitive announcements, complex topics and reputational issues in close collaboration with leadership and scientific teams.

Events: putting Orakl in the right room

  • Events strategy and prioritization. Build Orakl's annual events strategy and calendar, identifying the conferences, industry gatherings and scientific forums that matter most to the business (e.g. JPM, BIO, AACR, BIO-Europe). Define objectives, budgets and expected outcomes for each.

  • Conference presence and execution. Own Orakl's participation in major industry events, from sponsorships, booths and speaking opportunities to registrations, logistics, travel, vendors and on-site execution.

  • Business development activation. Work closely with BD and the founders to identify priority contacts, secure relevant meetings and build targeted engagement programmes around key events. Ensure opportunities are captured and followed up.

  • Orakl-hosted events. Create and run Orakl's own event formats, from intimate scientific dinners and executive roundtables to webinars and partner gatherings, designed to strengthen relationships and generate meaningful conversations.

  • Event content and experience. Own invitations, event branding, booth design, signage and communications before, during and after events, working with Product Marketing on offering-specific and scientific commercial content.

  • Event performance. Evaluate the impact of Orakl's events against their objectives, including strategic relationships developed, meetings secured, commercial opportunities generated and visibility achieved. Use these insights to refine future investments.

Internal communications and culture

  • Internal events. Plan and deliver company off-sites, all-hands gatherings and team celebrations that bring people together and strengthen Orakl's culture.

  • Internal brand alignment. Help teams understand and consistently communicate Orakl's mission, narrative and positioning, ensuring a coherent company voice as the organisation grows.

Building the function

  • Processes and partners. Establish the tools, workflows and external partner network needed to deliver high-quality communications and events efficiently, managing agencies, freelancers and budgets.

  • Measurement and priorities. Define how communications and events success is measured, focusing on quality of visibility, audience relevance, reputation, strategic relationships and contribution to company objectives.

  • Cross-functional collaboration. Work closely with founders, BD, scientific teams and Product Marketing to identify the strongest stories, align priorities and ensure communications supports Orakl's broader ambitions.

What we're looking for

  • Experience in communications, PR, brand or a related role, ideally within life sciences, biotech, healthtech or B2B technology.

  • Strong strategic communications skills, with experience developing corporate narratives, positioning and communications plans that support business objectives.

  • Exceptional writing and storytelling ability, from short-form social content and executive ghostwriting to press releases, long-form editorial, website copy and event communications.

  • Experience in media relations and thought leadership, with a track record of securing relevant earned media, interviews or speaking opportunities and building executive profiles.

  • Ability to communicate complex science, translating technical and scientific concepts into compelling, accurate stories for pharma decision-makers, investors, scientists and broader audiences.

  • Strong editorial judgment, with the ability to recognize what is genuinely newsworthy, identify compelling angles and choose the right audience, channel and moment.

  • Experience in events and conference management, from strategic planning and budgeting to hands-on execution, ideally with an understanding of how events can support commercial relationships.

  • A strong eye for brand and design, with the ability to maintain high creative standards across digital and physical touchpoints.

  • Hands-on and entrepreneurial mindset, equally comfortable setting a strategy, writing a LinkedIn post, pitching a journalist or running an event on-site.

  • Autonomy, creativity and pragmatism, with the confidence to work directly with founders, manage multiple priorities and make things happen in a fast-moving startup.

  • Work on-site with occasional remote work.

You don't need to come from a traditional life sciences communications background. We value people who combine strong storytelling instincts, intellectual curiosity, sound judgment and the ability to make complex ideas accessible without compromising their accuracy.

What Orakl offers

  • Shape the voice of an emerging category. Help establish Orakl as a recognised leader in virtual cancer patients and AI-driven drug development.

  • Work at the frontier of AI and cancer research. Bring breakthrough scientific advances to the audiences and organisations that can turn them into real-world impact.

  • Real ownership and direct access to leadership. Work closely with our founders and scientific experts, with significant autonomy, creative freedom and room to grow.

  • Amazon advertising management: own and optimize Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display and DSP campaigns across our markets, with one goal: prove and drive incremental revenue, not just efficient spend; use Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) to understand our audiences and buyers and measure what our ads really bring.

  • Process automation: rebuild our largely manual Amazon workflows (bid management, reporting, budget pacing, promo checks) into automated, scalable processes, leveraging AI tools and scripting rather than spreadsheets.

  • Data & reporting: collaborate closely with the data team to build and maintain dashboards and trackers monitoring ads performance and promotional impact, turning raw data into clear recommendations for leadership.

  • Promotions: manage promotional calendars across marketplaces to maximize conversion and defend competitive position.

  • Tooling & partner evaluation: continuously benchmark and test third party tools, agencies and tech partners (audiences analytics, competitive intelligence, etc.) to identify the best stack for scale.

  • Cross functional collaboration: work closely with the operations/catalog team, brand, and finance teams to align ads strategy with inventory, listings, and budget realities.

What we’re looking for:

  • 2+ years of experience in performance marketing or data analysis, or, with a strong analytical mindset (Amazon Ads experience is a plus, not a requirement)

  • Strong appetite for AI is a must, with dashboards, reportings or automated processes you’ve built using AI tools

  • Comfortable owning manual workflows and turning them into repeatable systems

  • Excellent organizational skills

  • Fluent in English; the role is based in Paris, and English is a prerequisite for both social and work life in our office

Nice to have:

  • Hands on experience with Amazon Ads console / Seller Central / Vendor Central

  • Interest in Web3/crypto

About Voodoo

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

This position is Paris-based, with relocation support available.

Team

For this position, you will be an integral part of a newly established internal studio, a dynamic and focused team dedicated to one of our most promising prototype in scale. This studio is specifically chartered to improve this high-potential game up to the successful and market-ready title it is meant to become.

You will be part of the team building Draft Showdown, a turn-based multiplayer game, working alongside its client engineers and game designers as a full member of the game team. You will be part of a small group owning the backend that this game needs as its requirements become more specific and demanding.

You’ll also be plugged into Voodoo's shared gaming backend platform - the same architecture and patterns that power titles like Mob Control and Block Jam 3D - building on it and contributing back, in close collaboration with the wider backend team. You get the focus and ownership of a dedicated game engineer with the leverage and support of a battle-tested platform behind you.

This is a pivotal hire: Draft Showdown is moving towards competitive multiplayer, which means moving game logic from the client to the server. They are also implementing cheat detection safeguards to the game.
You will be central to that transition.

Role

You will design and build the server-side foundation that takes Draft Showdown from a client-authoritative game to a competitive, server-validated one. The current game computes everything on the device - progression, economy, and match outcomes alike, which won't hold up for competitive PvP. Your job is to change that.

Working closely with client developers and game designers from feature design through delivery, validation and iteration, you will:

  • Build server-side validation for the metagame - currency, card upgrades, chest opens, and progression - staged by risk, replicating economy and reward logic on the server.

  • Move toward server authority for competitive features, where game state lives in one place and can be trusted.

  • Implement and improve matchmaking and cheat detection safeguards for a Deterministic lockstep PvP architecture

  • Design APIs and player-state management that the Unity client integrates against, and help shape how client and server split responsibilities.

The responsibilities are cross-functional, ranging from infrastructure, API design & coding all the way to client-side integration (we are using Golang).

To succeed in this role, you will need to have passion for everything you do. You love to write code that scales to millions of users, are skilled at requirements gathering, champion new tech initiatives & leverage existing solutions.

Profile

  • 5+ years of backend development experience

  • Strong knowledge of computer science fundamentals

  • Extreme fluency in Golang (at least 1 year in a professional environment)

  • Mastery of SQL and NoSQL

  • Background in high-scale systems

  • Understanding of Unix-like environments

  • AI-first mindset: Comfortable using AI daily and building custom agents or reusable automations to speed up your work

  • Experience working in cross-functional agile teams

  • Strong analytical skills with a track record of solving complex problems related to scalability, performance, and integration in high-stakes environments.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, capable of influencing teams and interfacing effectively with various stakeholders.

  • Ability to be self sufficient and work autonomously.

  • A deep interest in game development is a plus.

  • Based or willing to relocate in Paris

Benefits

  • Best-in-class compensation

  • Other benefits according to the country you reside

Le stage se déroulera au sein du service Sensibilisation-Communication de Handicap International, au siège de Lyon, du 1er avril au 30 septembre 2027. Il contribuera à la préparation et à l’animation des Pyramides de chaussures 2027, ainsi qu’à l’organisation d’autres événements de l’association.Les Pyramides de chaussures c’est le temps fort de sensibilisation et de mobilisation citoyenne pour Handicap International. Depuis plus de 30 ans, tous les citoyens, scolaires, salariés d’entreprises, sympathisants de Handicap International ou encore politiques sont invités à venir :

-          Lancer leurs chaussures pour témoigner de leur soutien aux causes portées par Handicap International, la chaussure symbole du poids
de l’engagement citoyen pour protéger les civils ;

-          S’informer à travers une exposition interactive, ludique et pédagogique sur Handicap International, ses champs d’intervention et ses combats ;

-          Rencontrer et échanger avec nos experts terrain.

 

Pour en savoir plus sur les Pyramides : https://www.handicap-international.fr/fr/pyramides-de-chaussures

Le stage associe coordination événementielle, relations avec les partenaires et prestataires, recrutement et animation de la communauté de bénévoles, préparation de supports et de matériel, animation et participation aux événements.

En complément, nous vous invitons à prendre connaissance des actions de sensibilisation et mobilisation en consultant : l’Espace du bénévolat et de la sensibilisation pour Handicap International.

La mission se déroulera du 1e avril au 30 septembre 2027 (6 mois).

Vos missions sont les suivantes

Activité 1 : Vous appuyez l’organisation et la coordination des Pyramides de chaussures de Villeurbanne et Paris avec

·       La participation à la conception et à la logistique opérationnelle des Pyramides (scénographies, matériel, présence sur événement, montage/démontage).

·       L’appui au recrutement, à l’animation et au suivi des bénévoles, ainsi qu’à leur formation et fidélisation.

·       La coordination de la Journée des Scolaires et l’organisation des visites guidées pour tous les publics.

·       La recherche de prestataires.

·       La contribution aux bilans : recueillir les retours des équipes et partenaires, documenter les résultats et proposer des améliorations pour les prochaines éditions.

Activité 2 : Vous participez à l’organisation d’autres événements de Handicap International

·       Congrès des Notaires : contribuer à la définition et à l’adaptation des messages clés, à la conception du stand et du parcours de sensibilisation, à la préparation des supports, du matériel et d’un kit d’animation, ainsi qu’à l’organisation.

·       Vœux 2028 : participer à la recherche et à la sélection d’un lieu insolite adapté à l’événement, imaginer des propositions d’animation et contribuer à l’identification, à la consultation et au suivi des prestataires.

·       Plus largement, apporter un appui à la coordination, à la logistique et au suivi des événements transversaux de l’Association Nationale France.

Activité 3 – Participer à la vie quotidienne du service Sensibilisation-Communication

·       Contribuer à la gestion de boîtes mail et au suivi des sollicitations, au suivi d’actions solidaires et à la préparation de nouvelles actions ou événements de mobilisation.

·       Contribuer à l'animation et au déploiement du défi de Damien Seguin pour l'inclusion et la solidarité internationale, avec un focus sur le volet scolaire : mobilisation et accompagnement des établissements scolaires, diffusion des outils pédagogiques, appui à l'organisation d'actions de sensibilisation et de défis solidaires, suivi des établissements participants et valorisation de leurs initiatives.

ACCESSIBILITE DU LIEU DE TRAVAIL :   Le poste est situé en Open Space, des box sont mis à disposition pour plus de calme si nécessaire et l’espace de travail est très lumineux. Le poste est facilement accessible en transports en commun (bus, métro). Un parking est également à disposition.   Concernant le bâtiment, des ascenseurs et des rampes d'accès sont mis en place.

Requirements

Profil recherché:

- Vous êtes en formation en gestion de projet évènementiel

- Vous avez une première expérience dans la gestion de projet évènementielle

- vous avez une aisance relationnelle avérée (public adulte et enfants)

- Vous avez un excellent niveau en français à l’écrit ainsi qu’à l’oral

- Une expérience dans le bénévolat serait la bienvenue

Benefits

CONDITIONS

Duree: 6 mois Type de contrat: Stage

Salaire: - Gratification mensuelle de 693€

- Tickets restaurant d’une valeur faciale de 8,96 euros (60 % à la charge de l’employeur, 40% à votre charge)

- Participation de 50% à votre abonnement au titre des transports

- Des déplacements sont à prévoir - De nombreuses activités sportives et sociales sont proposées dans nos locaux 

Vous devez disposer d’une convention de stage obligatoire délivrée par un établissement d’enseignement ou de formation français.

Les stages proposés chez HI donnent l’occasion aux étudiants d’évoluer dans une organisation internationale et de prendre part à l’action d’Humanité & Inclusion. Nous considérons que les stagiaires pour qui l’expérience s’est bien passée sont nos talents de demain !

Ingénieur Conception & Instrumentation – Équipements et bancs d’essais (H/F)

À propos de notre client

Notre client est une TPE basée au nord de Lyon, spécialisée dans les énergies du sous-sol : pétrole, gaz, géothermie et stockage de CO2. Son activité repose entièrement sur la R&D : essais sur géomatériaux, géomécanique et développement d'équipements d'essais pour des clients internationaux.

Son équipe pluridisciplinaire et multiculturelle développe des solutions technologiques innovantes au service de l'efficacité, de la protection de l'environnement et de la maîtrise des coûts. L'entreprise est certifiée ISO 9001 et toutes ses activités respectent sa démarche QHSE.

Le poste

Votre rôle : mettre au point de véritables méthodes d’essai. À partir d’un besoin de mesure (température, pression, déplacement, déformation, ultrasons…), vous concevez, instrumentez et validez des cellules d’essais haute température et haute pression. Vous commencez par fiabiliser une cellule existante : simplifier son montage et son démontage, puis la valider à plus haute température. Vous lancez ensuite les cellules suivantes.

Vous travaillez avec l’équipe qui conçoit aujourd’hui les équipements, et avec le bureau d’études d’un fabricant partenaire qui réalise la conception détaillée et les plans de fabrication. Environ 70-80 % conception et développement, 20-30 % laboratoire. Rattachement à la direction des opérations.

Ce que le poste n’est pas : ni dessinateur ou calculateur (le détail et les plans sont externalisés), ni management d’équipe. 

Vos missions

  • Définir le besoin, le cahier des charges et le pré-dimensionnement fonctionnel de nouvelles cellules.
  • Choisir les capteurs adaptés et les intégrer ; résoudre les enjeux d’étanchéité, de tenue en température et en pression.
  • Consulter fournisseurs et sous-traitants, suivre la fabrication des pièces.
  • Monter, instrumenter et tester vous-même vos équipements au laboratoire ; interpréter les mesures et améliorer.
  • Améliorer l’ergonomie des équipements existants et transférer les équipements validés à l’équipe d’essais.
  • Rédiger la documentation technique et contribuer à la protection de la propriété intellectuelle.

Requirements

Indispensable

  • Conception mécanique d’équipements, avec une CAO 3D (aucun logiciel imposé).
  • Instrumentation, capteurs et techniques de mesure physique et physico-chimique : choisir et intégrer, pas fabriquer.
  • Goût du terrain : vous aimez monter, démonter et intervenir vous-même sur les équipements.

Important

  • Gestion de projet : planning, budget, fournisseurs.
  • Rigueur, autonomie, communication proactive des difficultés.

Un plus

  • Anglais technique (échanges écrits avec des fournisseurs étrangers).
  • Mise en plan, notions de matériaux et d’isolation thermique.
  • Expérience en pression ou température.

Formation et expérience

  • Diplôme d’ingénieur (bac +5) en mécanique, génie physique, instrumentation ou mesures physiques. Un parcours associant mécanique et mesures physiques (BUT Mesures physiques puis école d’ingénieurs en mécanique) est particulièrement apprécié.
  • Environ 5 ans d’expérience en conception d’équipements, bureau d’études ou R&D ; profils plus juniors étudiés.
  • Poste orienté conception et terrain : une thèse n’est pas requise.

Conditions

Sur site. Manutention occasionnelle de pièces métalliques lourdes avec moyens de levage. Intéressement
Rémunération : 36 – 48 k€ brut annuel selon expérience

Benefits

Vous rejoindrez une entreprise à taille humaine où chaque développement compte : vos équipements seront directement utilisés pour des projets de R&D menés pour des clients internationaux. Vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe dynamique et multiculturelle, sur des sujets techniques exigeants au service des énergies du sous-sol et de la transition énergétique.

At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table.

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

Job Description

Reporting to the Experience Optimisation Director, you will play a key role in developing and implementing experience optimisation and conversion rate optimisation (CRO) strategies for a French multinational holding company specialising in luxury goods.

We take pride in delivering data-led experimentation, personalisation, and deep analytical insights for premier global brands, setting us apart in the industry. At Jellyfish, we are committed to fostering professional growth. Your career path could lead to progression into a CRO Senior Manager position with future potential to lead the practice.

This is a hybrid position, based out of our Paris office. The gross annual salary range for this position is between EUR 38,000-42,000, and the final offer is dependent on experience.

Responsibilities

  • Lead client meetings with a key luxury account to translate their business needs into strategic optimisation roadmaps aligned with their goals, driving measurable value and high client satisfaction.

  • Be the subject matter expert in conversion rate optimisation (CRO), experience optimisation, measurement, and marketing analytics across the client's brands.

  • Execute full-lifecycle user journey audits, research, continuous experimentation, and cross-channel activation campaigns to deliver actionable insights.

  • Define custom reporting and data-mapping requirements, collaborating cross-functionally to align technical solutions and timelines with strategic rationale.

  • Provide mentorship and escalation support for junior team members to foster professional growth and resolve operational challenges.

Qualifications

  • Fluency in French and professional-level English is required given the scope of work and the client teams.

  • Over 2 years of experience in end-to-end experience optimisation or CRO, including defining, launching, and evaluating A/B and Multivariate Testing (MVT) Campaigns using A/B testing platforms or website optimisation tools.

  • The ability to analyse user behaviour and map customer journeys from initial discovery to final measurement, ideally within the luxury, beauty or fashion industries.

  • Proficiency in web, app and product analytics combined with qualitative research tools (heatmapping, form analytics, live user testing) to uncover user behaviour insights.

  • Analytical and strategic mindset, with the ability to translate complex quantitative and qualitative data into actionable findings, recommendations, and optimisation roadmaps.

  • You love getting to know your clients, developing long-lasting relationships and adding value to their business.

  • When faced with a problem, you collaborate with the appropriate people to evaluate different options find practical solutions.

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

💰 Reward: You'll be eligible to join our discretionary annual bonus scheme.

💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours.

👪 Family Support: Enjoy 14 weeks of paid leave for primary caregivers and 4 weeks of paid leave for secondary caregivers. We also provide £1000 (or equivalent) towards courses for returning primary caregivers to support your transition back into work.

Unfortunately, there has been an increase in fake recruiters impersonating Jellyfish and unlawfully using our brand name. If you are unsure if an email with a job offer you have received is genuinely from Jellyfish, or if you suspect any fraudulent activity, please report it to

About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world's best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor.

Since the start, we've raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who've built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.

At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

The opportunity

As an AI Unity Tools Engineer, you'll build the next generation of QA automation and development tooling for Homa's games. This is a new, high-impact initiative, and you'll own it: from the first question to the tools running in production across our portfolio.

You’ll work across AI, Unity, QA automation, DevOps, and infrastructure to make testing and build pipelines more reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient for games developed by Homa and its studios. You'll be working on AI-driven QA automation at the edge of what is technically possible, and you'll see the impact directly in the speed, reliability, and cost of how our games are made.

What you'll do

  • Build. Design and deploy AI-enabled QA automation pipelines across Homa's major Unity games.
  • Run. Maintain and improve our TeamCity build pipelines and infrastructure so game builds stay reliable.
  • Scale. Onboard new games and tools onto the platform without reducing service quality.
  • Explore. Test AI-driven approaches to QA that cut manual testing effort and reduce reliance on costly legacy tooling.
  • Drive adoption. Work with developers, QA teams, studios, and mobile teams so the tools you build are actually used.
  • Measure. Track the impact of your work on testing time, build reliability, and cost, and turn it into clear recommendations.

Requirements

  • Ownership. You drive outcomes. When a build breaks or a test fails, you fix it instead of explaining why it broke.
  • Proactive. You don't wait for instructions or perfect conditions. You spot what needs doing and do it.
  • Pragmatism and simplicity. You look for the simplest solution that works, use whatever tools are available, and ship. You turn ambitious ideas into practical, achievable solutions.
  • Sharp thinking. You learn fast, reason from facts, and structure your ideas clearly. You can explain a complex technical solution to developers, QA teams, and studios in a few sentences.
  • AI-driven. AI is already part of how you work every day. You've used it to automate, speed up, or rethink at least one thing you're proud of.
  • Hungry and motivated. You're ambitious, high-energy, and grounded. You see this role as a chance to build something new and grow faster than anywhere else, and you're ready to work for it.
  • Bonus: you've built something. An internal tool, a testing framework, a game, a side project. We'd love to hear about it.

For this role, you'll also bring

  • Strong DevOps understanding, including TeamCity, build pipelines, and infrastructure.
  • The ability to work across technical topics while understanding the wider product and business context.
  • Experience working in a complex environment with meaningful product and testing volumes.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience building QA automation or testing frameworks.
  • Experience with AI-driven exploratory testing.
  • Experience in gaming or another Unity-based product environment.
  • Experience supporting products with high testing volumes.
  • Experience driving adoption of internal tools across multiple teams.

Even if you don't check every box, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Why Homa

  • Exceptional growth. We hire people of outstanding potential, then put them where they can grow fastest.

About Quandela:

Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.
Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

About this position: 

You will join the QPU Prototyping team, which develops and integrates the optical systems at the heart of Quandela's quantum processors, turning advanced R&D experiments into operational hardware. 

We are looking for a Senior Optical Systems Engineer to take ownership of a major optical development work package within our next-generation QPU programme. 

Your main challenge will be to maximise optical transmission and system performance, from experimental characterisation and precision alignment to qualification and integration. You'll tackle complex optical challenges, defining the right experimental approaches and driving solutions from investigation to validation. 

You will also coordinate technical activities involving several engineers and scientists, ensuring the delivery of critical milestones. 

This is a predominantly hands-on experimental role, combining deep technical expertise with project ownership.

Requirements

What you'll do: 

Develop and optimise optical systems 

  • Design, assemble, align and operate complex optical setups. 
  • Characterise optical transmission, identify losses and improve efficiency. 
  • Define measurement methods and improve stability and reproducibility. 
  • Troubleshoot experimental challenges and implement reliable solutions. 

Qualify and integrate optical subsystems 

  • Optimise research-developed optical subsystems for QPU integration. 
  • Define experimental tests, performance targets and qualification procedures. 
  • Collaborate with optics, electronics and system integration teams. 

Drive technical delivery 

  • Own technical deliverables within a major optical development project. 
  • Coordinate experimental activities across engineers and scientists. 
  • Plan tasks, milestones, equipment and laboratory resources. 
  • Anticipate technical risks, resolve blockers and guide contributors. 

The role combines approximately 80% hands-on experimental work and 20% technical coordination, with no initial requirement for formal people management. 
-

How you'll grow: 

First 3 months: Become familiar with Quandela's optical systems, experimental infrastructure and qualification objectives. 

Within 6 months: Take ownership of optical characterisation and optimisation activities, coordinating experimental work and technical milestones. 

Within 12 months: Lead the technical delivery of complex optical developments, with increasing autonomy over planning and resources. 

Longer term: Potential progression towards technical team leadership as the team grows. 

-

Requirements 

What we're looking for: 

We are looking for an experienced optical engineer or experimental scientist with strong hands-on expertise and the ability to drive complex technical projects. 

Relevant backgrounds include fibered optical systems, laser systems, experimental optics, and optical metrology. Academic and industrial experience are equally welcome. 

Must-have: 

  • PhD in Optics, Photonics, Physics or related fields. 
  • >5 years of experimental experience, including postdoctoral research. 
  • Hands-on expertise in complex optical systems, alignment and troubleshooting. 
  • Strong knowledge of linear optics, optical transmission and precision metrology. 
  • Proven ability to optimise optical performance and solve experimental challenges. 
  • Experience organising technical work and delivering project milestones. 
  • Experimental rigour, teamwork and professional English. French is not required. 

Important, but you can grow here: 

Technical & system integration 

  • Optical subsystem qualification and hardware integration. 
  • Python for experimental automation and data analysis. 
  • Semiconductor optics and quantum optical systems. 

Project & operational ownership 

  • Experimental planning, equipment and resource management. 
  • Coordination of multidisciplinary technical activities. 

Bonus: 

  • Experience transferring R&D setups into operational systems. 
  • Industrial qualification and reliability standards. 
  • Experience mentoring engineers or researchers. 
  • Exposure to quantum computing or advanced photonic hardware. 

Quantum computing experience is not required. What matters is your ability to understand complex optical systems, solve experimental challenges and deliver results. 

Benefits

Benefits 

Join a multidisciplinary team developing the optical systems for next-generation quantum processors, with substantial experimental ownership and opportunities for technical progression. 

  • Competitive compensation aligned with experience. 
  • Company savings plan and profit-sharing. 
  • 100% health coverage through Alan. 
  • Transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus. 
  • Swile meal vouchers. 
  • Gymlib and childcare support. 
  • Referral programme. 

Process 

  • Talent Acquisition interview (30–45 min) 
  • Hiring Manager interview (45–60 min) 
  • Technical discussion on previous experimental work 
  • Technical case study or presentation with the team 
  • Reference checks 
  • Team meeting 
  • Offer 

Beyond that: 

At Quandela, we value diverse scientific and engineering backgrounds, practical curiosity and the ability to learn from different fields. 

Whether your experience comes from an academic laboratory, industrial R&D or a different area of experimental optics, we'd love to hear from you if you enjoy tackling demanding technical challenges and turning experimental work into reliable results.
